_doc: Allowlist for yarn audit high/critical advisories. Every entry needs a reason and a review date. See SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md §5.

_fields.ghsa: GitHub Security Advisory ID — for humans
_fields.reason: why the advisory is allowlisted — REQUIRED
_fields.review: YYYY-MM-DD — REQUIRED, expired prints warning but does not fail

entries.reason: Build-time only via @graphprotocol/graph-cli. Path traversal on archive extraction; graph-cli extracts vendor-published npm tarballs, not untrusted input. No upstream fix (fix in <0.0.0), no released graph-cli drops decompress. Revisit if graph-cli publishes a version without decompress or if a fixed decompress ships.
